title: Dil thaam ke ye kubra ne kaha kyu mujh ko akela
body:
Dil thaam ke ye kubra ne kaha kyu mujh ko akela chord chale
Batlaao mujhe qasim dulha kyu mujh ko akela chord chale
<<DIVIDER>>
mu mod ke tum ko jaana tha gar chord ke mujh ko jaana tha
kyu haath mera thaama tha bhala kyu mujh ko akela chord chale
<<DIVIDER>>
raas aayi na bachpan ki shaadi dekho to meri ye barbaadi
kis jurm ki paayi maine saza kyu mujh ko akela chord chale
<<DIVIDER>>
shaadi thi meri kya qoob rachi sab mujh ko dulhan kehte the abhi
Aur kehte hai ab mujhko bewa kyu mujh ko akela chord chale
<<DIVIDER>>
chup kis lie ho bolo qasim baazu se rasan kholo qasim
Hoti hai bohot mujhko eeza kyu mujh ko akela chord chale
<<DIVIDER>>
ab koun kare imdaad meri ab koun sune faryaad meri
Koi bhi nahi sunne waala kyu mujh ko akela chord chale
<<DIVIDER>>
manzar tha qayamat ka wo 'nazar' phat'ta tha har ek ka gham se jigar
Ro ro ke jo kehti thi kubra kyu mujh ko akela chord chale
